Monthly fees generated by liquid staking protocols rose 14.6% MoM to $92M in October, marking the fourth consecutive monthly increase and the second-highest monthly total of 2026, behind only January's $124M.

Lido Finance remained the dominant protocol, generating 65% of the total fees in October, followed by EtherFi. Together, the two protocols accounted for 80% of the sector's monthly fees.
